no_rule_finding.finding: The LA City Council motion only instructs a city department to study the feasibility of banning algorithmic rent-setting software; no ordinance has been enacted in Los Angeles, unlike San Francisco which passed such a ban.
no_rule_finding.quoted_span:
I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council instruct the Los Angeles Housing Department to 
report on the number of ownership and management entities that are using algorithm-based 
software to establish rents and the feasibility of instituting a ban on the use of this software to set 
rents in the City.
